text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...I receive so much strength from everyone's relentless ambition and enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
By making the U.A.F. the best tournament possible,
I want to deliver this energy to as many people as I can.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching <chrname>'s training seemed
to fuel her enthusiasm even further.
